title: When anger takes over
issueStatement: The body is already hot and the mind is already arguing its case. Hurt, pride, and urgency have begun calling themselves truth.
centralInsight: Gurbani treats anger as fire that consumes discernment. The answer is not denial but cooling through humility, softened speech, and conquest of the mind.
practicalReflection: Anger promises strength while quietly handing the self over to impulse. What feels like power in the moment often leaves the heart smaller afterward.
actionPrompt: Before the next hard reply, give the heat one line of Naam and one breath more than it wants.
